notes.title: Let's keep jammin'
notes.content:
Dear WEJAMmers and Noise-Makers

We have a nice little update for you again.

[i]New stuff[/i]
[list]
[*] Fine-tuned all Instruments and Beats and added some cool new ones
[*] Added the option to use no beat at all
[*] Flashy transition when connecting
[*] Cute little animal avatars
[/list]

[i]Fixed stuff: [/i]
[list]
[*] Private Session were not connecting
[*] Various fixes and improvements under the hood
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy it!

On a side note, Hyperglide is currently on a 75% sale: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638520/Hyperglide/

notes.title: New WEJAM Update
notes.content:
Hey WEJAMMERS

We just published an update with the following features:
[list]
[*]Loopy - An easy to use looper that copies what you play in single player mode
[*]A small design refresh
[*]Translations in German, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Private Sessions - Give a code you your friend to jam in private
[*]Play with A S D F keys
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the comments.
Thanks

notes.title: The Hypergliders Demo is out
notes.content:
We released a Demo for another game of ours: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638520/Hypergliders/]Hypergliders[/url].  Check it out and don't forget to try out the Mouse Controls, they work like a charm.

Have fun gliding (not crashing! ) and we're looking forward to some feedback in Discord, the Comments or the Steam Forum.

Also, you can get a good discount on Hypergliders when the crowdfunding kicks off. Just make sure to add a notification here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/interactionideas/hypergliders

Your dev team.

notes.title: Our newest Game: Hypergliders
notes.content:
Hello everybody. 

Check out our latest game in development: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638520/Hypergliders/]Hypergliders[/url]. 

You can sign up for the Playtest right now and we will be also holding a competition with some steam gift cards as prizes. More info regarding the competition can be found in our Discord https://discord.gg/Rtq7usp or here https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1638520/view/3003321589584473682

notes.title: Zurich Game Show 2019
notes.content: This year we were at the Zurich Game Show presenting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094110?snr=2_9_100000_]WEJAM[/url] and a first prototype of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1140390/Hyperspeed_Fragfest/]Hyperspeed Fragfest[/url] to the public. The feedback was great, meeting the community and other game developers is always extremely inspiring. Thanks to everybody who played our games. See you all next year!
